negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-specific ATM / self-service / cash-handling trade exhibition with a published exhibitor list was found. English-language searches returned only non-Ukrainian events (PAY360 London, ATMIA roadshows, Fintech Poland Expo).
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian coverage of the ATM/self-service hardware channel appears to happen inside general fintech/payments conferences rather than a dedicated expo; no UA exhibitor directory located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Exhibitor lists are the cleanest enumeration of hardware/service suppliers competing for bank ATM and self-service tenders; without one, supplier discovery must rely on association partner lists and Prozorro award history.

negative_findings.description: For UAFIC (fintechua.org), UCBS (ukbs.org.ua) and AUB (aub.org.ua) the existence of a public, machine-readable member roster page was not confirmed from search snippets alone; only the association homepages/about pages were surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Membership counts were reported in secondary text (e.g. UCBS ~92 institutions, EMA ~64 organisations) but the canonical listing URLs were not established in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The member rosters are the core POINTER deliverable of this cell; if some are PDF-only, members-only or absent, the actor map must be assembled from event participant lists and registry data instead.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn — where Ukrainian banks and vendors most visibly post procurement/vendor-management roles and event announcements — is behind a login wall and its terms forbid automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only a single public post URL (UAFIC Ukrainian Banking Summit announcement) was reachable via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A significant share of the hiring weak signal for senior procurement roles at banks is on LinkedIn; excluding it biases coverage toward mass-market job boards and junior roles.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'НАБУ' collides between the banking association (Незалежна/Національна асоціація банків України) and the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine; 'ЄМА/ЕМА' collides with unrelated brand names.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language queries on НАБУ return heavy anti-corruption noise unless combined with 'асоціація банків' or the nabu.ua domain.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated keyword monitoring on these acronyms will produce large false-positive volume; queries must be domain- or phrase-anchored.

negative_findings.description: NABU appears under both 'Незалежна асоціація банків України' and 'Національна Асоціація Банків України' across its own pages and third-party references.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both variants were observed on nabu.ua-linked results in this pass; the current official Ukrainian name was not verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity resolution and query construction need both variants plus EDRPOU 37924657 to avoid missing content.

coverage_gaps.description: No page was fetched in this pass; all candidates rest on search-result evidence. Member-list URLs for UAFIC, AUB and UCBS remain to be located, and the EMA/NABU member pages' HTML structure is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a fetch pass over the association domains to locate and characterise the actual member/partner listing pages before building scrapers.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a targeted pass on PROSTIR participant lists and processor partner directories, in Ukrainian.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout association-run Telegram channels and Facebook pages; assess feasibility of a read-only Telegram collector.

brief: Ukraine's banking and payments weak-signal layer is unusually well organised around four associations — EMA (payment-system members), NABU and AUB (banks), UCBS (financial-credit institutions) and UAFIC (fintech) — whose member and partner directories together enumerate almost the entire buyer and supplier universe and therefore serve as the master POINTER set for all other A2 cells. Event infrastructure is concentrated in UAFIC-run properties (UAFIN.TECH, Pay.Forum, Ukraine Fintech Week, Ukrainian Banking Summit) plus trade-media summits (Power Payment Summit via PSM7) and the IT Ukraine Association calendar; their agendas and sponsor tiers read as a forward schedule of the modernisation themes banks intend to fund — SEPA readiness, instant payments/A2A, open banking, payment security. The hiring channel is served by work.ua, robota.ua, DOU and aggregators, where 'фахівець з тендерів' and 'менеджер з закупівель' postings at banks (a UKRSIBBANK/BNP Paribas procurement role was already visible) expose internal buying structures months before publication, though the richest senior-role signal sits on LinkedIn behind a login wall and ToS restriction. Nothing here was fetched or liveness-checked: association member-list page structures, banks' own career pages and processor/PROSTIR participant lists remain the priority follow-ups.
